svg.title: Peblo AI Hub: Connections (models, Peblo MCP Server, Peblo Connect)
svg.desc: Mid-fidelity wireframe of the Connections tab of the AI Hub. Three columns: model providers (Ollama detected models, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, cloud keys, routing and privacy rules); Peblo MCP Server (on/off, copy-config for Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code, connected clients with permissions, activity log); Peblo Connect (external MCP servers, their tools and trust level, and an Add server form).
svg.text: turn it on. Nothing here opens
